name: nivor-agent-engine-sanitized
description: Sanitized, plug-and-play workflow for the Nivor Autonomous Agent Engine. API keys and local URLs removed; replace environment placeholders before running.

config.notes: Do NOT hardcode an API key here. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in your environment.
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment if you use Anthropic nodes.
Replace with an absolute path or set NIVOR_PERSISTENCE_DB env var. Do not include local dev-only paths.
Strip local URLs and auth. Use environment variables or secrets.

secrets_instructions: All secret values MUST be provided through environment variables or a secret manager. Replace placeholders like ${OPENAI_API_KEY} with real values in your deployment environment; do NOT commit keys to Git.
